name: thermosyphon_hx
title: Thermosyphon (heat-pipe) tube-bank heat exchanger with ESDU operating limits
summary: Crossflow heat-pipe heat exchanger: flue gas over the evaporator bank, water boiling/condensing inside each thermosyphon (ESDU pool/film resistances, vapour pressure drop, axial wall conduction), boiling Cyclopentane over the condenser bank, ESDU operating limits per row, marching solution over 61 tube rows. Translation of the LaboThapPy HexThermosyphon.

verification.summary: Not verified end-to-end: both files fail to converge in CoolSolve 0.4.0. The CS-BUG-PROC-NEG-POW check (integer powers rewritten as products, fractional bases guarded, all inlined variables initialised) did not change the outcome; the correlation procedures were solved standalone at the model operating points and the reference numbers come from re-running the source example (7 bisection iterations, residual 9.7e-4).
verification.reference: hex_thermosyphon_example.py re-run in a throw-away venv (CoolProp 8.0.0): cold outlet 516.861 K, hot outlet 543.364 K, sum Q_dot_row 5.869 MW; standalone procedure checks against CoolProp 8.1.0-dev
verification.notes: Status failing; no .sol baseline exists. neg-pow rewrite + procedure inlining + full initialisation do not make the coupled blocks converge; equations verified piecewise (standalone procedures vs CoolProp; constants-substituted variant of the row equations converges). Follow-up 2026-10-31 documented in README.

diagnosis: CoolSolve 0.4.0: Newton/KINSOL stop with SingularJacobian at iteration 0 on the coupled blocks; tearing hits a singular Schur complement naming a pure CALL-output equation (a_g, sound speed, used by no other equation); Partitioned does not move from the initial residual. Same equations with the CALL outputs replaced by constants converge; each CALL converges standalone. Reported as an unverified suggestion, not registered as a gap (no minimal reproducer).
